_meta.source: Extracted from sydevs/WeMeditateWeb@main — the literal each key replaces is listed in Appendix A of sydevs/SahajCloud#707. The `discover` group and `meditation.general.upsell_*` come from sydevs/SahajCloud#917, which lists the file and line each literal sits on. `common.general.skip_to_main` replaces no literal: the site renders no skip link today, and sydevs/WeMeditateWeb#162 asked for it. The six `meditation.general` finder keys replace no literal either: they are the meditation library sydevs/WeMeditateWeb#272 asked for, which the site has never had. No screen-reader-only string lives here: WeMeditate Web owns those itself, machine-translated, in lib/i18n/a11y/.
_meta.schema_version: post-#1223 (13 tabs, 13 leaf groups, 104 declared keys)
_meta.shape: Mirrors the global's API response: <tab>.<sub-group>.<key> for a nested tab, <tab>.<key> for a flat one (navigation, footer). A `plural: true` key is stored expanded — English populates `_one` and `_other` only, since English has no `few`/`many` form.
_meta.placeholders: `%{name}` interpolation, resolved by the consuming site. `%{count}` is reserved for the number that selects the plural form.
